steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...It's getting darker and darker.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's as if the clouds are pressing into the skyline...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The air still feels clear, but the dark clouds aren't moving. It feels like all the stress is being compressed into a single point.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even the wind has stopped...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: No doubt about it. A Catastrophe is about to befall this city.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: By the looks of things, Chernobog has been completely paralyzed by Reunion's attacks.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But when it comes to disabling a nomadic city, the preparations must have been made several weeks in advance.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Could Reunion have taken some other action since then...?

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: That's a bit unrealistic.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Based upon what we've seen, Reunion currently doesn't show the kind of discipline required to stage a covert takeover.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Most Reunion members are still wandering the streets, taking revenge on Chernobogians.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's all just senseless fighting, killing, and arson.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: When the Catastrophe falls, even the impregnable Chernobog will be shattered...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...and turn into Originium-filled ruins.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: If fame or fortune is what they're after, Reunion is doomed to failure.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even with Ursus's chain of command in shambles, I still doubt that Reunion is able to face their military...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why hasn't the Ursus military staged a counterattack yet?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: From my experience, when a riot breaks out, the military usually manages to quash it immediately.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But we did just witness the Ursus guards getting overpowered...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: That masked Reunion leader might have been a cut above the rest... but there's no way she could single-handedly destroy the entire city.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Unless...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Unless what?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I've fought in many battles before...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I've seen many people who acted in the same way as that Reunion leader.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: To them, soldiers are nothing more than pawns to be tossed away as soon as they've served their purpose.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Soldiers could be used efficiently when needed, and then left to their own devices when not needed.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Because the cost of training and maintenance is too high.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: So, there's no standing army?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Right. Most of the time, they simply have to be fed with some hatred or fear...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: All that's needed to whip them into a frenzy... is a little push.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: If the way that Reunion leader acted was any indication for how the organization is run...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Any Infected could join Reunion simply by donning a uniform and putting on a badge?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Correct..

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: So... that explains their endless numbers.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: There are too many oppressed Infected, desperately trying to cry out. No matter how tenuous the solutions that Reunion offers them might be...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: As long as they see a light at the end of the tunnel, they will gladly lay their lives down to pursue it, even if it means jumping into a sea of hellfire.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: They are not like us. Even if I don't fully trust you, I at least trust your abilities.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: And completely unlike you...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: That kind of leader is no commander.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Those who would trample enemies and comrades alive... or rather, 'minions.'

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Perhaps not even minions. To Reunion, those thugs may have been nothing more than pawns.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: This is not a leader, but a tyrant.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: No matter who our enemies are, we will complete our mission.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Someone once taught me and my teammates--

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: 'If facing a pawn, capture it; If facing a fortress, topple it; If facing the Crown, overthrow it.'

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Ace, wait a minute.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, enemy light-armored troops are stationed in front of us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Have we been found?

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Not yet.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: However...

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: We won't be able to avoid them. The route we're on is the shortest one; if we take a detour, we'll lose time we don't have.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: No need for further discussion then. Thugs or pawns, all that matters is that we clear them out of our way!
